1.consolidated_definition: “Entrarle a uno a chuponazos.” “Entrar(se) a burrunazos.” Darse golpes dos o más personas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To collide with someone in a series of blows. To engage in mutual punching or hitting with one or more people.
